font-weight.$description: Font weight scale from light to bold.

light.$description: Light weight. For large display text where a delicate appearance is desired.

regular.$description: Regular weight. Default for body text and UI labels.

medium.$description: Medium weight. Slightly bolder for emphasis in compact spaces.

semibold.$description: Semibold weight. For sub-headings, table headers, and navigation items.

tight.$description: Tight line height. For headings and display text where vertical space is limited.

snug.$description: Snug line height. For sub-headings and medium-length titles.

normal.$description: Normal line height. Default for body text. Balances readability and density.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed line height. For long-form reading and accessibility-sensitive contexts.

loose.$description: Loose line height. For single-line labels with generous vertical padding.

tighter.$description: Tighter tracking. For large display headings where letters should optically close.

tight.$description: Tight tracking. For headings and sub-headings.

normal.$description: Normal tracking. Default for body text.

wide.$description: Wide tracking. For all-caps labels, badges, and overline text.

wider.$description: Wider tracking. For spaced-out small-caps and brand wordmarks.

semantic.$description: Composite type tokens bundling font size, weight, line height, and tracking into role-based presets.

duration.$description: Transition duration scale from instant to slow.
